priorBehavior: Completion could close an assigned request when its original exact delivery and timer were complete while a task-issued manual Wake remained unresolved.

guards.completedContinuation: Exact journaled Wake, SENT receipt and matching completed response timer

cases: An existing queued manual Wake retains the original OPEN work record
A live scoped tool call prevents closing the request
A SUBMITTING manual Wake without a receipt remains unresolved after the tool call settles
A SENT Wake with an unfinished response remains unresolved
Both exact response timers complete before closure, and the existing close retry is idempotent
verification.fixture: Isolated Git and Wake store with simulated receipts and browser progress
